notes.title: Été v.1.1.0 Beta: Performance patch
notes.content:
Hi painters!

I've been hard at work on a performance patch since release. The goals are to give more graphical options, improve framerate, reduce loading times, reduce memory usage, and fix memory leaks (which might be the cause of crashes on Steam Deck).

This patch is now available on the Beta branch of Été. The full instructions to download it and the full changelog can be found on this Steam Discussions post.

While this patch is a large step in the right direction, there is more that could be done. However, further optimizations will take significant time to implement and I wanted to make sure the community had access to at least a functional beta before the Holidays.

I hope this makes your Été experience smoother this holiday season! Cheers!
- Lazlo

notes.title: Été v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Été v.1.0.2 is a minor patch consisting mostly of bugfixes.

However, one often request quality of life change made it in: while at the easel (painting on canvas), time will pause at dusk, meaning you will no longer get kicked out of painting to sleep! You can spend as much uninterrupted time as you want painting an artwork. Do note however that earlier in the day, time will progress normally, all the way to the end (dusk).

Full change log:

 Changed: Disable time passing at dusk while at easel
 Changed: Increase first burst charge requirement during tutorial
 Fixed: Missing ruined brick walls from album
 Fixed: Impossible to store decorations
 Fixed: Floating avatar spike in safari tent moment
 Fixed: Oversized bus stop in apt diorama
 Fixed: Dyslexia-alleviating font broken in some interface elements
 Fixed: Unreachable drops above some lampposts
 Fixed: Unreachable drops on tarp of Fabienne's workshop
 Fixed: Utility poles not fully filling visually
 Fixed: Decoration duplication bug when using the debug panel
 Fixed: Possible to get stuck in furniture pile during moving day argument in Alleyway


Thanks to everyone who reported bugs! Keep them coming!

Artwork Mailing

Mailing artworks no longer removes them from the game
Any artwork can now be mailed, even those turned in for quests or sold
Previously mailed artworks will be returned to the portfolio upon updating

notes.title: Thanks for a wonderful launch! What’s next for Été…
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34966687/16a69893cf9faa2bc32085a4889a99f2a1e4af4b.png Thank you! 🙏 

What a week! From the bottom of our hearts, we want to thank our players, streamers and critics for this wonderful launch. We’re overjoyed that Été is sitting at 100% positive reviews on Steam and that you all seem to be having a great time coloring Montreal!

 What’s next? 👀 

Now that the baby bird is out of the nest, we wanted to take a moment to let you know what our next steps are. In the coming weeks and months, there will be patches and updates to improve the Été experience.

Our priorities will be, in this order:

1. Fixing bugs, starting with anything critical
2. Optimizing the game’s performance
3. Quality of life features and tweaks

Let’s cover each of these!

 Bug fixing & reporting 🐞 

Thankfully, the bugs that have been reported since launch seem to be mostly minor, but we’ll get started on fixing them right away! Note that we will always prioritize bugs that are “critical”, that is, anything that prevents you from progressing in a quest or story, for example.

We’ll add a “Known Issues” sticky post to the Steam Discussions so you can follow our progress.

The Steam Discussions is also a great place to report any new bug you find!

 Performance & optimization 🐇 

We heard you: Été has some performance issues. The main culprits that have been reported are loading times between scenes and FPS stutters, especially when the time of day changes.

First, as the main (and only!) programmer on the game, I want to apologize to anyone getting those slowdowns. I did my best to optimize as much as possible before launch, but with our deadlines looming, not every optimization could make it in time. I fully intend to keep optimizing the game post-launch to alleviate those as much as possible. 

My main goals will be to:

- Reduce loading time between scenes
- Stabilize the FPS in highly detailed areas
- Eliminate (hopefully!) the stutter when time of day changes
- Reduce the RAM & VRAM usage of the game

In the meantime, here are some performance tips:

- Don’t play on 4K resolution if you don’t have a high-grade PC; switch to 1080p
- Disable V-Sync to improve framerate stability
- Reduce graphics settings to mid/low

 Quality of life ✨ 

Once bugs have been fixed and performance has been improved, we’ll have time to focus on quality of life features & tweaks. We already have a few ideas in mind from seeing people play in streams in the past week, but we’d love your input! If you have ideas for small changes to the game that could make your experience more enjoyable, please share them with us!

 Join the community! 💬 

Speaking of! Want to get in touch with the devs? Showcase your artworks? Get decoration tips? Stay up to date with the latest news? 

Join our Discord! It’s a small and cozy server that we hope will grow to welcome all travelling painters.

Here’s the invite link: https://discord.com/invite/DTfJ9SY6KU

That’s it for today!

Thanks again for playing Été and for your patience as we get those little hiccups sorted out.

Cheers!
